title: Midsummer Run
description: Cross the brightest June morning, a flower valley and sunlit climb to a huge midsummer plateau and golden-evening horizon.

signs.text:
The midsummer morning
Begin beneath the longest day’s sky

The flower valley
Follow the wide valley’s bellflower arcs

The sunlit hill
Climb from flowers into the long light

The midsummer plateau
A broad high crossing under an enormous sky

The golden-evening horizon
Keep moving into the warm evening light
